title: Agnus Dei (de Orto, Missa [Ad fugam])
desc: Marbrianus de Orto, Missa [Ad fugam], Agnus Dei. 4 voices (Discantus, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
